sections.title: Dispatch board
sections.sql: select code,due_on,customer,batch,required,available,short_units,batch_status from v_dispatch order by due_on

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by kind,record

sections.title: Stock by batch and location
sections.sql: select batch,product,location,status,units,litres,litres_alcohol,age_days from v_stock where units<>0 order by batch,location

sections.title: Movement evidence
sections.note: Record preparation only. No duty rates, WET calculations or return filing. Confirm classification and licence conditions with your adviser.
sections.sql: select * from v_excise_records order by occurred_on,ref

sections.title: Missing evidence
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by rule,record
